## Summary

Describe the focused change, affected layer and developer-visible behaviour.

## Validation evidence

List the exact commands, runtime/context and observed results. Identify skipped checks and missing prerequisites separately; do not equate static validation with a live deployment.

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass with output reviewed.
- [ ] Commands, paths and documentation match current script contracts and manifests.
- [ ] Configuration changes were reviewed against the official schema and effective policy.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Only synthetic data; no credentials, identifying data or unsafe prompt/log attachments.
- [ ] Input validation, safe errors, exact monetary arithmetic and fixed-string JSON contracts preserved.
- [ ] Legacy/demo exceptions respected only within their documented scope.
- [ ] PowerShell compatibility and ShouldProcess/confirmation checked where applicable.
- [ ] Required extensions remain distinct from optional modernization recommendations.
- [ ] Volatile platform claims cite current official sources with support limitations.

## Operational impact

Describe required approvals, elevation/restart implications and sample-scoped recovery. State whether any setup, repair, application/container launch, Azure authentication or deployment was actually executed. Documentation edits alone do not authorise those actions.
